_help: Settings for the weekly automatic update. You normally never need to edit this file. See the notes on each item below.
_help_quartiles: Journal ranking badges (Q1/Q2...). OpenAlex does not provide quartiles, so add a line here when a paper appears in a new journal. Use the journal name in lowercase.
_help_exclude: If a paper that is NOT his ever appears on the site, paste its DOI (e.g. 10.1016/j.xxx.2025.123) or its exact title here, inside the brackets, in quotes, separated by commas.
_help_extra: Items that online databases usually miss (conference papers without a DOI). They are always shown. Add new ones in the same format.
